Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of fatigue in the setting of a strong family history of early heart disease.

I am sending Henry Parker, a 74-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism, for evaluation of persistent fatigue over the past several months.
